subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 upstream action revisions for workflows that execute with credentials or security-sensitive permissions?
rationale: Automated checks can validate workflow syntax and observed execution, but they cannot decide whether maintainers trust the new third-party action code at privileged boundaries.

options.title: Approve exact revisions
options.body: Secops and workflow owners review the upstream deltas, refresh the branch if needed, and merge the exact checked head after required checks complete.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker credential-path updates if an owner needs to hold or investigate one upstream revision independently.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Close or supersede this batch if owners reject any material upstream trust or compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Approve exact revisions
recommendation.body: Secops and workflow owners review the upstream deltas, refresh the branch if needed, and merge the exact checked head after required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most directly connects steipete to repository-wide action-runtime modernization, while CODEOWNERS supplies the required secops review.
